dedupe_keys.name: world bank bank regulation and supervision survey brss

description: A global database of how banks are regulated and supervised, country by country. The World Bank data catalog page says the survey gathers information from bank regulators on entry and licensing, ownership, capital, activities, auditing, governance, liquidity, depositor protection, provisioning, disclosure, problem institutions and exit, supervisory powers, sector characteristics, consumer protection and Islamic banking; that waves were issued in 2001, 2003, 2007, 2012 and 2019 (the last completed in 2019 with a 2021 update); and that it covers more than 180 countries, with about 80 in all waves. The databases are free Excel downloads, with the questionnaire; metadata were last updated on 29 January 2026. Coverage is global, by country. Caveats: country participation varies by wave. For simulation it gives the rules on deposit insurance, capital and resolution that shape how banking systems absorb shocks. A related catalogue record is the BIS consolidated banking statistics.
